definition: means the policy shall be void and all premium paid hereon shall be forfeited to the Company in the event of misrepresentation, mis-description or non-disclosure of any material fact.
plain: The clause stating that the policy is void, and premiums forfeited, if information was misrepresented, mis-described or withheld.
whyItMatters: This is the legal teeth behind the proposal form. It is not aimed at honest mistakes about detail, but it does mean a deliberately omitted condition can void the entire contract rather than just that one claim. It is the reason to over-disclose rather than under-disclose.
